text: dsh-workbench 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的实验性 Cordis 插件骨架，通过 bundle 清单将插件条目挂载到 Harness profile，并导出 Cordis 所需的 name 与 apply 生命周期入口。当前实现中的 apply 为空，不注册工具、服务、事件或模型上下文，也没有实际用户功能。它适合需要检查 Harness 插件包与 profile 挂载结构的开发者作为空白起点；本身不能增加 DSH 能力。源码未显示需要 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-workbench is an experimental Cordis scaffold mounted in a DeepSeek Harness profile by a bundle manifest. It exports name and apply, but apply is empty and registers no tools or services. It adds no user feature; source shows no API key or external service.
想找一个最小的 Cordis 插件包示例，看看怎样通过 bundle 清单挂进 DSH profile。
需要一个导出 name 和 apply 生命周期入口的 DeepSeek Harness 插件空骨架。
dsh-workbench 的功能「profile 挂载骨架」：bundle 清单插入插件包条目，入口导出 Cordis name 与空 apply。将包纳入 Harness profile 后可作为插件结构起点，但当前不提供实际运行功能。

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · dsh-workbench：English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

An experimental, independently maintained plugin workbench for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Status：This repository contains a valid Cordis plugin and an installable DeepSeek Harness bundle manifest. The plugin intentionally contributes no tools, services, events, model context, or runtime I/O while its first concrete feature remains undecided.

There is no stable release and `@geecraft23/dsh-workbench` has not been published to npm. Do not add this package to a production profile yet.

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Development baseline：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.2-alpha.4`
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `^4.0.2`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- pnpm `11.7.0`

DeepSeek Harness is in prerelease development. Compatibility is limited to versions exercised by this repository's tests and CI.

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Project layout：| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | Named Cordis plugin entry point |
| [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) | Bundle layer that mounts the package in a Harness profile |
| [`tests/`](tests) | Lifecycle, Loader composition, and bundle-manifest checks |
| [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) | Reproducible verification on supported Node.js lines |

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Project layout：The package exports `name` and `apply` as named exports. It does not expose a CLI or start a Harness application; supported applications continue to launch through `dsh` profiles.

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Develop：Prerequisites: a supported Node.js version and pnpm `11.7.0`.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run verify
pnpm run pack:check
```

`verify` runs linting, strict TypeScript checks, per-file coverage, the build, a built-entry smoke test, and package-publication validation. `pack:check` shows the files that would enter a package without publishing it.

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Develop：The bundle metadata supports Git-host installation through the Harness plugin manager, and the `prepare` script builds TypeScript sources for that path. Source installation executes package code during installation; review the source and pin a commit before allowing its build. User installation instructions will be added only after the plugin provides useful behavior.

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Runtime and data impact：The current plugin performs no file, network, process, credential, telemetry, or persistence operations. It adds no model-visible text or tool schema and therefore has no direct token or KV-cache effect. Future changes that add any of these behaviors must document their permissions, data flow, failure behavior, lifecycle cleanup, tests, and model impact.

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · Contributing and support：Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before opening a pull request. Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/geecraft23/dsh-workbench/issues) for public bugs and feature proposals. Report vulnerabilities privately as described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · dsh-workbench：[English](README.md) | 简体中文

一个面向 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)、由社区独立维护的实验性插件工作台。

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · 当前状态：本仓库已经包含有效的 Cordis 插件入口和可安装的 DeepSeek Harness bundle 清单。在第一个具体功能确定之前，插件不会注册工具、服务、事件或模型上下文，也不会执行运行时 I/O。

项目尚无稳定版本，`@geecraft23/dsh-workbench` 也未发布到 npm。请勿将它加入生产 profile。

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · 开发基线：- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.2-alpha.4`
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `^4.0.2`
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- pnpm `11.7.0`

DeepSeek Harness 仍处于预发布开发阶段。本项目只对测试和 CI 实际覆盖的版本作兼容性声明。

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · 项目结构：| 路径 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| [`src/index.ts`](src/index.ts) | 使用命名导出的 Cordis 插件入口 |
| [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) | 将本包挂载进 Harness profile 的 bundle 配置层 |
| [`tests/`](tests) | 生命周期、Loader 组合和 bundle 清单检查 |
| [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml) | 在受支持 Node.js 版本上执行可复现验证 |

本包通过命名导出提供 `name` 和 `apply`，不提供 CLI，也不自行启动 Harness 应用；受支持的应用仍统一通过 `dsh` profile 启动。

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · 开发：准备受支持的 Node.js 版本和 pnpm `11.7.0`，然后执行：

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run verify
pnpm run pack:check
```

`verify` 会依次执行代码检查、严格 TypeScript 检查、逐文件覆盖率测试、构建、产物入口冒烟测试和包发布结构验证。`pack:check` 只展示将进入发布包的文件，不会发布任何内容。

bundle 清单已经支持 Harness 插件管理器从 Git 仓库安装，`prepare` 脚本会为该路径构建 TypeScript 源码。从源码安装会在安装阶段执行包内代码；允许构建前应审查源码并固定到具体 commit。插件具备实际用途后再补充用户安装说明。
@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · 运行时与数据影响：当前插件不会访问文件、网络、进程、凭据、遥测或持久化数据。它不会增加模型可见文本或工具 schema，因此没有直接的 token 或 KV Cache 影响。后续变更若引入这些行为，必须同时说明权限、数据流、失败行为、生命周期清理、测试和模型影响。

@geecraft23/dsh-workbench README · 贡献与支持：提交 Pull Request 前请阅读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。公开缺陷和功能建议请使用 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/geecraft23/dsh-workbench/issues)。安全漏洞请按照 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。
